title: Speaking Practice 21 - Education System
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about education system.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Education System Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: What are the biggest problems in the education system today?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I think the biggest issues are outdated curricula that don not match job market needs and the overemphasis on exams rather than practical skills.

questions.content: Should all university education be free?

explanation.sampleAnswer: While free education sounds ideal, it would require massive government funding. A better approach might be subsidized education with scholarships for those in need.

questions.content: How will technology change education in the future?

explanation.sampleAnswer: AI-powered personalized learning will likely transform education, adapting to each student pace and learning style. Virtual reality could make subjects like history and science more immersive.
explanation.tips: Use future tenses and give examples

questions.content: Do you think online learning is as effective as classroom learning?

explanation.sampleAnswer: For self-motivated students, online learning can be equally effective. However, many students need the structure and social interaction of a physical classroom.
